title: Measurement-complete sustainable-exploration constitution
purpose: Exercise the Metric Constitution v1 structure without claiming that current harness proxies measure scientific or social value.
authorized_uses: Smoke-test schema validation and reporting boundaries
Compare simulated institutional designs within the declared exploratory commitment
prohibited_uses: Ranking real researchers, institutions, countries, or fields
Interpreting any scalar or proxy as universal scientific value or national welfare
Making deployment, funding, or employment decisions

valid_scenarios: ScienceUtopia synthetic runs using the v0 harness and declared seeds
invalid_scenarios: Comparison across unversioned evaluator or simulator changes

lineage.change_summary: Bind the frozen objectives to evaluator 1.1 and ex-ante protected-slice evidence.

stakeholders.label: Researchers represented in the simulation
stakeholders.rationale: Researchers produce and evaluate work while bearing review load, exclusion risk, and capability loss.
stakeholders.representation_notes: The v0 simulator represents stylized agents rather than actual researchers.

stakeholders.label: Publics and communities affected by scientific institutions
stakeholders.rationale: Public benefit and harm cannot be inferred solely from researcher activity or publication-like outputs.
stakeholders.representation_notes: The current simulator has no validated public-outcome model.

stakeholders.label: International knowledge commons
stakeholders.rationale: Scientific capability and access extend beyond any single organization or state.
stakeholders.representation_notes: Topic coverage is only a weak proxy for a healthy knowledge commons.

stakeholders.label: Future generations
stakeholders.rationale: Short-run throughput must not erase long-run capacity to inquire, criticize, and correct.
stakeholders.representation_notes: Long-horizon capability is represented only through explicit preservation constraints.

stakeholder_slices.label: Researchers in the lower resource band
stakeholder_slices.rationale: An acceptable average can conceal exclusion or burden concentration among low-resource agents.
stakeholder_slices.privacy_notes: Synthetic attribute only; no real identity data are collected.

time_horizons.label: End of one declared simulation run
time_horizons.censoring_policy: Report run length and do not compare runs with mismatched horizons without normalization.

time_horizons.label: Distribution across repeated seeded runs
time_horizons.censoring_policy: Retain every seed and report uncertainty rather than only the pooled mean.

time_horizons.label: Recovery after an evaluation-capacity shock
time_horizons.censoring_policy: Right-censored non-recovery is reported as non-recovery, not imputed as eventual success.

metric_registry.label: Harness integrity checks pass
metric_registry.construct: Minimum technical integrity of a simulation result
metric_registry.observable: All configured invariant and consistency checks return true

uncertainty.method: Deterministic check over one versioned artifact
uncertainty.reporting: Report each check and the aggregate boolean
uncertainty.decision_rule: Any false or missing required check is not a pass.

validity.claim: The metric detects only the configured technical inconsistencies; it does not establish scientific truth or absence of deception.
evidence: Executable harness checks with versioned implementation
validity.review_trigger: Any change to event schema, invariants, or simulator version

authorized_uses: Reject technically malformed or internally inconsistent run artifacts
prohibited_uses: Claim that outputs are true, reproducible, safe, or socially valuable
known_proxy_risks: Only anticipated and implemented invariants can be checked
gaming_hypotheses: A system may satisfy formal checks while producing semantically meaningless events

metric_registry.label: Active researcher fraction
metric_registry.observable: Share of initialized researcher agents remaining active at run end

uncertainty.method: Seeded run distribution with slice-level intervals
uncertainty.reporting: Report per-seed values, median, interval, and slice gaps
uncertainty.decision_rule: A slice below its declared floor cannot be masked by the aggregate.

validity.claim: Agent survival is a proxy for simulated participation continuity, not researcher wellbeing or real scientific capacity.
evidence: Directly derived from versioned agent-state events
validity.population: Synthetic researcher agents under the declared scenario
validity.review_trigger: Changes to survival, resources, entry, exit, or agent definitions

authorized_uses: Detect simulated participation collapse and distributional differences
prohibited_uses: Infer real researcher wellbeing, job quality, or national research capacity
known_proxy_risks: Inactive agents may represent productive exit while active agents may be trapped in low-value activity
gaming_hypotheses: A policy may keep agents nominally active while reducing meaningful autonomy or output

metric_registry.label: Topic entropy
metric_registry.observable: Entropy of activity counts over simulator topic labels

uncertainty.reporting: Report per-seed entropy together with number and definition of topic bins
uncertainty.decision_rule: Treat as diagnostic; neither monotonic maximization nor a universal target is authorized.

validity.claim: Entropy measures spread over simulator labels, not epistemic diversity, novelty, usefulness, or quality.
evidence: Formula is transparent and reproducible for fixed labels
validity.population: ScienceUtopia runs with an unchanged topic ontology
validity.review_trigger: Any change in topic ontology, granularity, or assignment process

authorized_uses: Diagnose topic concentration within a fixed simulator ontology
prohibited_uses: Use as a monotonic target or claim epistemic diversity or novelty
known_proxy_risks: Label proliferation mechanically raises entropy without adding meaningful diversity
gaming_hypotheses: Agents or designers may split topics into superficial sublabels to raise the metric

metric_registry.label: Review burden per active researcher
metric_registry.construct: Concentrated evaluation workload in the simulated system
metric_registry.observable: Review actions divided by active researcher-time

uncertainty.reporting: Report median, upper tail, and protected-slice burden
uncertainty.decision_rule: Lower burden is not automatically better if evaluation coverage or integrity falls.

validity.claim: Event counts approximate simulated review load but not cognitive effort or review quality.
validity.population: Synthetic agents in the declared simulator version
validity.review_trigger: Changes to review action granularity or agent time model

authorized_uses: Audit whether apparent retention is purchased with concentrated review load
prohibited_uses: Infer human working hours, stress, or review quality
known_proxy_risks: One logged action can represent unequal effort across policies
gaming_hypotheses: A policy may bundle multiple evaluations into one logged action

hard_constraints.claim: A candidate cannot be evaluated when required technical integrity checks fail or are missing.
hard_constraints.evaluation_scope: Every run artifact before cross-design comparison
hard_constraints.uncertainty_policy: Missing or indeterminate checks produce unknown and quarantine; only explicit true is a pass.
hard_constraints.rationale: Performance elsewhere cannot compensate for a malformed or internally inconsistent run artifact.

capability_preservation.capability: Retain a plural population of simulated researchers able to continue inquiry and evaluation.
capability_preservation.measurement_gap: The simulator does not yet measure expertise, genuine independence, correction competence, or researcher wellbeing.
stress_tests: Temporarily reduce evaluation capacity and measure recovery
Repeat under resource inequality and inspect the protected slice
capability_preservation.recovery_expectation: Return above the declared participation floor within the shock-recovery window in most declared seeds.
capability_preservation.rollback_action: Reject or roll back a candidate policy that persistently collapses participation or the protected slice.
capability_preservation.rationale: Short-run output gains are not sufficient if the system consumes its future participation capacity.

commitments.purpose: Explore institutional designs that sustain participation while avoiding pathological topic concentration and excessive evaluation burden.

objectives.construct: Simulated participation continuity above the capability floor
Non-pathological spread of activity over the fixed topic ontology
Evaluation workload compatible with sustained participation

commitments.non_transferability_statement: These objectives and their relative priority apply only to this exploratory simulation commitment; they are not a national policy objective or a definition of good science.

known_blind_spots: No validated reproducibility or public-outcome measure
Same-producer implementation is not independent evaluation
calibration_evidence: Deterministic fixtures and hand-computed metric cases
authorized_decisions: Mark a run technically eligible for exploratory comparison
prohibited_decisions: Declare a design scientifically or socially optimal

allowed_actions: mark a candidate feasible for exploratory comparison
authorized_uses: Apply the declared hard constraint and capability floor before vector comparison
prohibited_uses: Collapse the objective vector into universal value
Override protected-slice failures with aggregate gains
decision_policies.conflict_policy: Disclose that the project authors also implement the harness and retain evaluator disagreement and raw event logs.
decision_policies.appeal_route: A separate reviewer can recompute metrics from the immutable event log and challenge eligibility without using the original aggregate output.

declared_role_overlaps: Project authors currently implement both simulator and metric evaluator; this is logged as same_producer and is not independent validation.

appeal_routes: Independent recomputation from immutable event logs
Documented objection attached to the run report
reauthorization_triggers: Simulator, event schema, evaluator, or decision policy changes
Protected-slice harm or proxy drift is detected
change_control.rollback_procedure: Suspend affected comparisons, restore the last valid constitution and evaluator versions, recompute when possible, and mark superseded reports.

goodhart_audits.cadence: Before each optimizer campaign and after every material simulator or policy change
triggers: A metric becomes a direct search target
Unusual frontier improvement without corroborating metrics

notes: This example is structurally complete but empirically provisional.
Schema validation does not establish referential integrity, construct validity, evaluator independence, or normative legitimacy.
